prompt: I want to distribute numbers 1-50 in 10 groups. In such a way that when you add all 5 numbers in a group, all groups would have an equal total sum.
judge_reasoning: The prompt requires 10 groups of 5 numbers each from 1–50 with equal group sums. The total sum 1–50 is 1275, so each group would need sum 1275/10 = 127.5, which is impossible because a sum of 5 integers is always an integer. Candidate 1 correctly concludes impossibility (even though it also suggests an unrelated 1–40 alternative), while candidates 2–4 provide incorrect, inconsistent, or non-viable groupings and/or rely on non-integer targets.
